Title: FI TUNE 2.0.0 is here
Description: FI TUNE 2.0.0 adds playback recovery, optional glass styling, refreshed branding, a wave-style AOD player, and update checks. If 1.0.4 doesn't list it, download 2.0.0 from GitHub and install over the existing app; no uninstall is needed.
Author: FI TUNE Developer

Title: Playback fix: update FI TUNE to 1.0.4
Description: We fixed a playback issue that could show "No stream available" when YouTube rejected an audio stream. Update FI TUNE to 1.0.4 to get the fix.
Author: FI TUNE Developer
